correctness.rationale: For two unordered particles on the ten-edge K5 with every edge subdivided once, independently reconstructed the cubical cell counts C0=105,C1=260,C2=150, and spanning-tree quotient with 156 cycles. Independently assembled the integral signed 156x150 2-boundary; exact Smith reduction gives 149 ones and one 2 (remaining six free), hence H1=Z^6⊕Z/2. The total-motion projection to H1(K5;Z)≅wedge^2 A4 is surjective since one particle can traverse each triangle while the other stands at another vertex; torsion kernel Z/2 is S5-trivial. Independently recomputed the mod2 projection columns [7,25,42,4,16,1,3], the natural S5 transposition/5-cycle linear maps, and the 42-variable equivariant-section system: consistent rank 41, exactly two binary sections. Since the torsion kernel injects on reduction mod2 and the integral quotient is free, each binary equivariant section uniquely lifts by correcting any integral ordinary section with a Hom(W,Z/2) map; conversely there are no additional integral sections. Sufficient subdivision for 2 particles holds on the subdivided K5; this finite computation is exhaustive for the specified space, not arbitrary graph configurations.
